name: Destruction Of Sodom
overview: The destruction of Sodom serves as a solemn biblical example of God's judgment against grievous sin, particularly sexual immorality and rebellion against His design, as seen in the city's wickedness and the angels' visit to Lot. Leviticus explicitly condemns same-sex relations as an abomination warranting severe consequences, highlighting the severity of such offenses. Jude further emphasizes that Sodom and Gomorrah's fate demonstrates the eternal fire of divine vengeance reserved for those who abandon God's standards and pursue sinful desires.
